scope: Partial EK08: fixed pair subtitle layout repair, not speech/editorial/native acceptance
behavior: Only explicit dry repair previews collect measured bounds/overlap errors; fixed text is not shrunk, source words/clocks remain authoritative. Strict default, final=True and encoded outputs refuse invalid layouts. Invalid clocks/fonts remain hard errors.

Timeline and live HF preview opt into repair. Manual Save requires selected cue free of errors and every remaining issue exactly equal to a baseline issue, including geometry and time; other bad cues can then be repaired incrementally. Browser/local imports remain strict.

Display-only normal/emphasis inputs preserve source and keyword timing; full source edits remain separate. Existing second/color options are retained. Save disables its form and guards timeline adoption against panel navigation; failures retain input and show complete wrapped error.
regression_before_fix: Both new repair tests failed: overflow timeline HTTP400 and valid first-cue Save HTTP422 while another cue remained invalid.
